answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 21284 Country: India Title: My Name is Mohammed Ozeir(Uzair). Please tell me the meaning of Mohammed Uzair and hadith on the name if it is related? Question: My Name is Mohammed Ozeir(Uzair). Please tell me the meaning of Mohammed Uzair and hadith on the name if it is related? Answer ID: 21284 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 551/413/D=1431) Hadhrat Uzair ( عليه السلام ) was a pious slave of Allah. He learnt Taurah by heart. This name of yours is good. Some more details are mentioned in Ruhul Ma'ani (vol. 6, p 80) under the following verse: وَقَالَتِ الْيَهُودُ عُزَيْرٌ ابْنُ اللّهِ الخ [التوبة : 30] Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
